An interactive guide to anticipatory humanitarian analysis.

About this site

This practical guide to rapid anticipatory humanitarian analysis is based on a method developed by Madeleine Lyons and Barbara Devlieger.

The method has been tested with a group of humanitarian analysts. The version on this website is adapted and extended by Matthew Gwynfryn Thomas; the code is available on GitHub under an MIT license.
